text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of 『Reading Promotion Week』, 
which we had prepared together with Zenno 
Rob Roy and the others—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it beforehand, but the crowd in 
the central plaza really is incredible... 
I just hope my nerves don't make me bungle 
this...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you whining about now? We've come 
this far, so all that's left is to give it 
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... You truly are amazing, Sweep-san... 
Always so composed and confident—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah? My heart pounds like crazy too 
whenever I'm trying out a new spell, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even a genius magical girl can fail 
sometimes... But Grandma always told me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magic requires: a handmade wand, a 
mysterious incantation, —and a tiny 
fragment of courage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Courage...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's magic or promotion, you won't 
get anywhere being scared! You can't 
succeed unless you try, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it! And spread the wonder of 
magic to everyone out there! ...What about 
you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to make it a success too! 
Because I want people to discover the 
stories I love so much—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A fragment of courage... I will summon 
mine as well... !

text_block_list.name: Passerby Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
What's up with those girls? Dressed up 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Passerby Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
They're promoting 『Reading Promotion 
Week』~ Wonder if it's different from last 
year?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(There are even more people now than when 
I looked earlier...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, nothing begins if I stay 
afraid. I have to muster my courage and 
step forward— Right, Sweep-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the story that staked everything 
on the event's success finally raised its 
curtain—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is a timid girl. When her 
friend is turned into a frog by a curse, 
she embarks on a journey to find a witch 
who knows the counterspell... that was the 
tale.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...No way. Is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Only the true hero can cast the 
counterspell. If anyone else recites it, 
they will turn into a frog themselves!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(A timid girl, just like me... Her words 
once gave me so much courage.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Even while frightened, having a wish she 
wanted to grant, she said this—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even so... cowardly as I am... even if I'm 
far from being a hero—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I don't summon courage, my wish will 
never come true! For the sake of the one 
precious to me, I will definitely make 
this succeed...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
『Twinkle Twinkle☆』, return to your 
original form~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A resolute, unwavering voice echoed across 
the square. Immediately starting the 
background music, I jumped onto the 
story's stage in the role of the friend.
choice_data_list:
Thank you! Thanks to you, I'm back to 
normal!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It worked... ! Even though I'm not a hero 
at all...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Setting out on a journey for a dear 
friend, casting magic without regard for 
the peril—you are no coward. You are a 
magnificent hero.

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you all so very much for watching 
until the end... !

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Right now, the library committee has an 
exhibition in the audiovisual room... 
Wonderful tales are waiting for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If you can experience the worlds of these 
stories... and come to love them... It 
would make me so very happy...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, want to go check out the 
exhibition?

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This year's looks pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the promotion wrapped up safely. 
As for what happened to the exhibition 
corner—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I knew visiting the fantasy booth first 
was the right choice~♪ Look, so many 
people have fallen under magic's spell...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good work, my little heroes. I saw your 
promotion in the central courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Every story is so captivating... ...My 
"friend" is delighted as well...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: R-Really...! I'm so glad...!

text_block_list.name: Exhibition Guest Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, library committee member over 
there! Could you give us a detailed 
breakdown of this story, please?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... "Rob Roy"...
choice_data_list:
Why not go on over, Madame Library 
Committee Member?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, with pleasure...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Summon your courage and tell them... 
about what I love... I want everyone to 
love it too—the heroic tale of "Rob Roy"!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the first day of "Reading Promotion 
Week" concluded with resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the period, the current 
Zenno Rob Roy would surely do just 
fine—seeing her puff out her chest and 
explain with pride made me feel that way 
naturally.
